notes: Tests that IncludeMacro.execute() invokes authorExecutor.call() when author=CURRENT and context=CURRENT. On vulnerable code, the condition at line 199 only checks Author.TARGET and Author.AUTO, so authorExecutor.call() is never invoked when Author.CURRENT is specified — the included content inherits the calling page's elevated author rights. The fix adds '|| parameters.getAuthor() == Author.CURRENT' to the condition.
